metadata.description: I swear I’m a comedy fan and I’ve never seen a sheep with this much chaos in its little woolly heart—this roasting is absolutely WILD. The attitude? Unbothered. The punchlines? Straight-up ruthless. It’s playful, it’s ridiculous, and somehow it still hits harder than it should—LIKE if this sheep ended you! Comment who to roast next, and don’t forget to Follow Woolly Roasts for more savage animal comedy. You’re about to get served. 🐑💀
